text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Franca Van Dunem speaking on the 21st anniversary of Angola's independence in the coastal port city of Lobito called for Angolans to live in harmony and peace.
- Prime Minister Franca Van Dunem said the government would fund to the tune of one million dollars the completion of 90 apartments in Benguela town, south of the capital Luanda.
- Angolan President Jose Eduardo dos Santos relaunched a hospital for the physically disabled in Luanda after it stood without funding for two years.
- Namibia expelled 52 Angolans for illegally living in the country.
